description: One recorded penalty against an employee. Deliberately has no effect on salary: it feeds the level that HR acts on, not the payslip.

fields.description: When it happened. A penalty dated in the future is a mistake and is rejected on save.
fields.label: Penalty Date

fields.description: Kept open-ended rather than tied to attendance types, because the working vocabulary differs by company and HR is the one who knows it.
fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Absenteeism
Late Arrival
Policy Breach
Misconduct
Quality
Safety
Customer Complaint
Other

fields.description: Weight, not a count. A verbal warning is 1, a formal written warning 3, a case escalated to HR 5. Levels are thresholds on this, so escalating a single penalty never means editing old rows.
fields.label: Points

fields.description: Only Open and Acknowledged penalties count towards the level. Waived and Withdrawn are kept for the record but stop counting; Expired is set automatically once expires_on has passed.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Optional. After this date the penalty stops counting, so an old warning does not follow someone for the rest of their career. Blank means it counts until waived.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: What happened, in the words the employee was actually told.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: What was done about it, if anything. The level's own action is separate and comes from the Penalty Level.
fields.label: Action Taken

fields.description: Left as Administrator unless set, so a penalty raised by a script is attributed honestly rather than to nobody.
fields.label: Issued By

fields.description: Ticket, email or note this came from.
fields.label: Reference

name: SDG Penalty
